cohort: 291 women with term singleton pregnancies, medical indications for induction of labor, and an unfavorable cervix, across different BMI categories.
finding: Oral misoprostol is an effective and safe method for labor induction across all BMI categories, though higher maternal BMI correlates with modestly prolonged induction times and increased misoprostol dose requirements.
mod_finding: Oral misoprostol achieved high vaginal delivery rates (77.3%) across all BMI categories, with higher BMI correlating with longer time to delivery.
